brief: Entirely instrumental progressive electronic space strategy game soundtrack. Compose a completely new piece, approximately three minutes, with distinctive melodic phrases and answering motifs. Crystalline FM bell sequences, glassy synth plucks and a graceful expressive electronic melody in a vast resonant hall. Introduce a motif and a moving inner pattern, develop a first full statement with changing harmony, thin the texture into a contrasting middle passage, then return with a developed variation and interlocking counterpoint. Atmospheric but rhythmically alive, curious and mysterious, never a static drone or an unchanged repeated hook. This score will support calm and driving arrangements.
